thickness_assessment.rationale: Modern concrete guidance distinguishes ordinary concrete overlays of approximately 70–100 mm from thin proprietary cementitious screeds. An 80 mm topping is selected for the representative loose-fill cap; the guidance is an analogy for buildability, not evidence of a specific 1943 thickness.
